poly-saudi-oil-pipeline-east-west-restar.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline is flowing again by Sep 30. The line carries crude from the eastern oil fields to Yanbu on the Red Sea, the kingdom's route for oil that avoids the Strait of Hormuz.
poly-saudi-oil-pipeline-east-west-restar.recent: Attacks on the pipeline in mid-month raised the prospect of oil at its highest in months. Word of a restart then pushed Brent below $98, but the fighting widened. France sent soldiers and radars to guard Yanbu, the UK committed an RAF tanker to refuel Saudi jets striking the Houthis, and Saudi defences downed Houthi drones aimed at Riyadh.

poly-will-jean-luc-mlenchon-win-the-2027.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Jean-Luc Mélenchon, founder of the left-wing La France Insoumise, wins France's 2027 presidential election. He has run three times and narrowly missed the runoff in 2022.

poly-will-gavin-newsom-win-the-2028-us-p.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Gavin Newsom, the California Democrat, wins the 2028 US presidential election. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves with the early race for the Democratic nomination.

poly-us-x-iran-diplomatic-meeting-by-sep.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if US and Iranian officials meet by 30 September 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves with the messages mediators carry between the two governments.
poly-us-x-iran-diplomatic-meeting-by-sep.recent: The rebound from mid-September followed Tehran's first written terms: seven conditions for ending the war sent to Washington through Qatar, and Hormuz terms passed on by mediators. Trump has talked of meeting Iranian officials at the UN, yet told the same assembly he could "annihilate" Iran.

poly-will-mary-peltola-win-the-alaska-se.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Mary Peltola, the Democrat who once held Alaska's lone House seat, wins the state's US Senate race. Alaska has not sent a Democrat to the Senate since 2008.

poly-us-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-throu.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the ceasefire between the United States and Iran still holds on October 31. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome.
poly-us-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-throu.recent: Trump rejected Iran's offer to reopen Hormuz within 7 days. Hours later, explosions hit Qeshm Island, and Iran said it had seized a second US seabed drone. Two days after that, TASS, citing Axios, said Trump would offer Iran sanctions relief, and US forces began leaving Iraq after 23 years.

poly-will-russia-enter-sloviansk-by-dece.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Russian forces enter Sloviansk, a city in Ukraine's Donetsk region. With neighbouring Kramatorsk, it anchors the largest urban belt Kyiv has held there through the war.
poly-will-russia-enter-sloviansk-by-dece.recent: The fortnight's news about the war was fought in the air and over energy, not on the ground. Ukrainian drones set a Moscow refinery alight, Trump pressed Kyiv to stop refinery strikes as Macron floated an energy truce, and the EU and Washington funded weapons and air defence. None of it concerns fighting near Sloviansk or explains the price.

poly-will-jd-vance-win-the-2028-us-presi.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if JD Vance, Donald Trump's vice president, wins the 2028 US presidential election. The price is what traders pay for that outcome, and it moves on primaries, endorsements and Trump's own signals.
poly-will-jd-vance-win-the-2028-us-presi.recent: Nothing in the fortnight's news touched the 2028 race or Vance. The prediction-market stories were about the venues themselves: New York sued Polymarket for letting 18-to-20-year-olds bet, and an appeals court ruled that states can regulate Kalshi's sports contracts. Neither explains this price.

poly-will-franois-hollande-win-the-2027-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if François Hollande, France's Socialist president from 2012 to 2017, wins the 2027 presidential election. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, in cents on the dollar.

poly-will-marco-rubio-win-the-2028-repub.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Marco Rubio wins the Republican nomination for president in 2028. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it shifts as the field of rivals for the nomination forms.

poly-bab-el-mandeb-strait-effectively-cl.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Bab el-Mandeb, the strait between Yemen and the Horn of Africa, is closed to shipping by October 31. Tankers and container ships heading to or from the Suez Canal pass through it.

poly-will-david-lisnard-win-the-2027-fre.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if David Lisnard, the centre-right mayor of Cannes, wins France's 2027 presidential election. Its price is what traders pay for a long shot in a crowded field on the French right.

poly-will-naftali-bennett-be-the-next-pr.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Naftali Bennett, who unseated Benjamin Netanyahu in 2021 at the head of a broad coalition, becomes Israel's next prime minister. The price is what traders will pay for that outcome.
poly-will-naftali-bennett-be-the-next-pr.recent: The fortnight's Israeli headlines centred on a Haaretz report that the UAE warned Netanyahu of a Hamas plan days before 7 October, which he threatened legal action over, and on 12 countries moving to sanction settlement trade. None of it concerned Bennett or an election date, and none of it accounts for the price.

poly-will-yulia-navalnaya-win-the-nobel-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Yulia Navalnaya, the Russian opposition figure and widow of Alexei Navalny, wins the Nobel Peace Prize. The Norwegian Nobel Committee names the laureate in Oslo each October.

poly-will-russia-enter-kramatorsk-by-dec.standing: A contract that pays out if Russian forces enter Kramatorsk by the end of 2026. The city became Ukraine's administrative seat for Donetsk after 2014 and, with Sloviansk, anchors the last urban belt Kyiv holds in the region.
poly-will-russia-enter-kramatorsk-by-dec.recent: The fortnight's news from the war centred elsewhere: Trump pressing Kyiv to stop hitting Russian refineries, Macron pressing him on an energy truce, and a $2.68 billion US air-defence sale awaiting Congress. None of it concerned the ground fighting around Kramatorsk.

poly-will-trump-and-putin-not-meet-432.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin do not meet in person before its deadline. Its price is what traders pay for that outcome, and it moves on summit talk and on Ukraine ceasefire diplomacy.
poly-will-trump-and-putin-not-meet-432.recent: The fortnight's reporting on Russia centred on the EU delisting Alisher Usmanov and Mikhail Fridman to keep its sanctions regime alive; nothing in it concerns a Trump–Putin meeting or accounts for traders shifting their bets.

poly-will-josh-shapiro-win-the-2028-demo.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Josh Shapiro, the governor of Pennsylvania, becomes the Democratic nominee for president in 2028. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, long before any primary ballot is cast.

stocks:ORCL.standing: The Austin-based maker of the Oracle database and business software such as PeopleSoft, now spending heavily to build cloud data centres for AI customers. Its share price tracks how investors judge that debt-funded buildout.
stocks:ORCL.recent: The slide coincided with a fortnight of Oracle trouble: filings showed Larry Ellison had pledged 346 million shares, worth $50 billion, as loan collateral; Oracle was found liable to pay investors in its Doña Ana County data centre even if power never arrives; and ShinyHunters restarted attacks by exploiting PeopleSoft's own patch workaround.

stocks:MSFT.standing: The share price of Microsoft, maker of Windows and Office and owner of the Azure cloud, listed on Nasdaq. It is one of the world's most valuable companies, and investors watch it for what businesses spend on cloud computing and AI.
stocks:MSFT.recent: The news about Microsoft in these weeks was about security and AI. A Patch Tuesday release fixed 973 vulnerabilities, and CISA warned that two were being exploited. Court filings quoted a Microsoft executive calling AI scraping "the largest theft of labor in human history". None of it accounts for the share price.

poly-us-announces-end-of-iranian-blockad.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the US blockade of Iran ends by Oct 31, 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves with Washington–Tehran talks and incidents around the Strait of Hormuz.
poly-us-announces-end-of-iranian-blockad.recent: Iran offered to reopen Hormuz within 7 days, and Trump rejected the proposal; explosions hit Qeshm Island hours later, and Iran said it had seized a 2nd US seabed drone. Hormuz authorities then threatened to blacklist charterers, even as TASS, citing Axios, said Trump would offer Iran sanctions relief.

poly-will-kamala-harris-win-the-2028-us-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Kamala Harris wins the 2028 US presidential election, priced in percent. Harris was the Democrats' losing nominee in 2024, so the contract prices a second run and a comeback.

stocks:AAPL.standing: Shares of Apple, the Cupertino company that makes the iPhone, traded on Nasdaq. It is one of the largest companies in the world by market value, so its moves carry heavy weight in the S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100.
stocks:AAPL.recent: Apple shipped a rebuilt Siri in iOS 27 as the iPhone 18 reached stores at higher prices. The UK made it pull its strongest iCloud encryption for new users. A San Diego jury then awarded Taction Technology $5.72 billion over a haptics patent. None of these reports connects any of it to the share price.

wiki-pakistan.standing: Daily reads of Wikipedia's article on Pakistan, a nuclear-armed country of about 240 million bordering India, Afghanistan, Iran and China. It climbs when the country's wars, politics or disasters reach a global audience.
wiki-pakistan.recent: A mosque bombing targeting police killed 31, and days later Pakistan struck 10 Afghan sites in Khost it called drone launchpads; Afghanistan's defence ministry says its forces killed 28 fighters from Pakistan. In Islamabad, the IMF wants 174 amendments to the law, and protests are banned in the capital as PTI rallies for Imran Khan.

poly-will-the-republicans-win-the-maine-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if a Republican wins Maine's 2026 US Senate race, for the seat Susan Collins holds. Maine leans Democratic in presidential races and counts its Senate ballots by ranked choice.

poly-will-dan-sullivan-win-the-alaska-se.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Dan Sullivan, Alaska's Republican US senator, wins his seat's election. The price is what traders pay for that outcome, and it moves on polling, candidate news and control of the Senate.

poly-variational-fdv-above-1b-one-day-af.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether the token of Variational, a crypto derivatives trading platform, is valued at $1 billion or more when it launches. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, which makes it a live read on appetite for new crypto tokens.

poly-will-the-price-of-bitcoin-be-betwee.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if bitcoin settles between $84,000 and $86,000 on its resolution date. It is one rung in a ladder of adjacent price bands, so its price shows where bettors are putting money along that ladder.
poly-will-the-price-of-bitcoin-be-betwee.recent: The news on bitcoin this fortnight pointed lower: it sank to $77,000 as CPI landed with hike odds near 70%, then slipped again as Clarity Act odds faded when Republicans rejected Democrats' counter-proposal. Nothing reported from the days this band gained explains why bettors moved into it.

stocks:NET.standing: Shares of Cloudflare, whose network sits in front of a large share of the world's websites and handles their traffic, DNS and attack filtering. When it goes down, much of the web goes down with it.

stocks:VLKAF.standing: Volkswagen's shares as traded over the counter in the US, in dollars. The Wolfsburg group owns VW, Audi, Škoda and most of Porsche, and as Europe's largest carmaker it carries the region's exposure to the electric transition.
stocks:VLKAF.recent: Volkswagen wrote down $11.5 billion, mostly on Porsche, as Germany's carmakers cut jobs. Days earlier Handelsblatt reported that Porsche could face another 4,000 job cuts. The group also lost Škoda chief Klaus Zellmer, whom Volvo Cars appointed as CEO to lead a turnaround.

stocks:MBGYY.standing: The US over-the-counter dollar quote for Mercedes-Benz Group, the Stuttgart maker of premium cars and vans. China is one of its largest markets, so Chinese demand and EU and US trade rules drive its profits.
stocks:MBGYY.recent: The only related report in these weeks was the EU's August registrations, in which electric cars took 27.7% of sales. It names no carmaker and does not explain the fall in the share price.

poly-will-jd-vance-win-the-2028-republic.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if J.D. Vance wins the Republican nomination for the 2028 presidential election. Its price is what traders will pay for a share in that outcome, and it tracks the party's succession after Trump.

poly-2026-balance-of-power-r-senate-d-ho.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays if the 2026 midterms leave Republicans running the Senate and Democrats the House. That split would give House Democrats subpoena power and a block on legislation, while confirmations stay Republican.
poly-2026-balance-of-power-r-senate-d-ho.recent: The fortnight's prediction-market news concerned the venue, not the races: New York sued Polymarket as an illegal gambling operation for letting 18-to-20-year-olds bet where state law sets 21. Nothing reported about the Senate or House contests accounts for the price.

poly-will-gavin-newsom-win-the-2028-demo.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Gavin Newsom of California becomes the Democratic presidential nominee in 2028. Its price is what traders will stake on that outcome, and it moves on polls, fundraising and rivals' entries.
poly-will-gavin-newsom-win-the-2028-demo.recent: Nothing in the fortnight's news concerned Newsom or the Democratic field. The stories that touched this market were about the venue itself: New York sued Polymarket for letting 18-to-20-year-olds bet where state law sets 21, and that suit does not explain the price.

poly-will-luiz-incio-lula-da-silva-finis.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, the Workers' Party leader who has won Brazil's presidency three times, places second in the 2026 election. Its price is what traders will pay for him losing first place.

poly-will-the-republicans-win-the-nebras.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays a dollar if a Republican wins Nebraska's 2026 US Senate race. Its price is what traders pay for that outcome. Nebraska last elected a Democratic senator in 2006.

poly-will-save-the-children-win-the-nobe.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Save the Children, the children's charity founded in London in 1919, is named Nobel Peace Prize laureate. The Norwegian Nobel Committee announces the prize in Oslo each October.

wiki-european-union.standing: A political and economic union of 27 European countries that share a single market and a common trade policy, and most of them a currency. Its rules on competition, data and product standards bind firms far beyond its borders.
wiki-european-union.recent: EU chief von der Leyen proposed an "associate member" status for Canada, a category no EU treaty defines, and Mark Carney spoke in Strasbourg the next day; soon after, Ottawa's own Brussels envoy played the label down. The same week the Commission set 13 and 15 as EU-wide minimum ages for social media.

poly-2026-balance-of-power-d-senate-d-ho.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out only if Democrats win control of both the Senate and the House in the November 2026 US midterms. Its price is what traders will pay for a Congress able to stall the White House's legislative agenda.
poly-2026-balance-of-power-d-senate-d-ho.recent: The fortnight's news about prediction markets was about the markets themselves: New York sued Polymarket for letting 18-to-20-year-olds bet, and an appeals court ruled that states can regulate Kalshi's sports contracts. None of it concerned the Senate or House races, and none of it explains this price.

poly-will-no-fed-rate-cuts-happen-in-202.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Federal Reserve gets through 2026 without lowering its benchmark interest rate even once. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on inflation data and Fed signals.
poly-will-no-fed-rate-cuts-happen-in-202.recent: The Fed raised rates on a 12-0 vote and blamed a supply shock from a closed strait. Goldman Sachs had dropped its no-hike call days earlier, and the 10-year Treasury yield reached 5%. After that hike, and with traders pricing in 4 Fed rate hikes by June 2027, very few wanted to bet on a cut before year-end.

wiki-united-nations-general-assembly.standing: The United Nations' main deliberative body, where each of the 193 member states holds one vote. Its resolutions are not binding, but every September its general debate puts heads of state at one podium in New York.
wiki-united-nations-general-assembly.recent: Trump used the Assembly's opening week to warn he could "annihilate" Iran and to call global AI oversight a globalist scheme. Days later nearly 70 delegations walked out as Netanyahu spoke. On the sidelines, Iranian officials held three hours of direct talks with Witkoff and offered to reopen Hormuz.

poly-will-jon-ossoff-win-the-2028-us-pre.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Jon Ossoff, the Democratic senator from Georgia, wins the 2028 US presidential election. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, not a forecast of it.

stocks:TSLA.standing: Shares of Tesla, the US electric-car maker run by Elon Musk. Its valuation rests far more on bets about self-driving and robotics than on the cars it sells, so the stock swings on Musk's promises as much as on deliveries.
stocks:TSLA.recent: The fortnight's news on Tesla was about what comes after the cars: Musk set Oct. 1 for the long-delayed Roadster, Fremont workers balked at training the Optimus humanoid robots meant to replace them, and Kalshi sought 24/7 perpetual contracts on Tesla and Nvidia. None of it accounts for the share price.

poly-will-jon-ossoff-win-the-2028-democr.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Jon Ossoff, the Democratic US senator from Georgia, wins his party's 2028 presidential nomination. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, not a poll.

stocks:COIN.standing: Shares of Coinbase Global, the largest US-listed cryptocurrency exchange. Its revenue rides on trading volumes and on interest from USDC reserves it shares with Circle, so the stock moves with crypto prices and Washington's rules.
stocks:COIN.recent: The slide began when the Senate rejected the Clarity Act, the crypto market-structure bill, and Coinbase fell nearly 9% in a day. The rebound followed the SEC's five-year exemption for tokenized stocks, a business analysts said Coinbase, Robinhood and Circle stand to gain from.

stocks:BA.standing: America's largest aerospace company and one half of the global duopoly in large passenger jets, alongside Airbus. Its shares move on 737 delivery rates, safety findings and regulator scrutiny, and on US defence contracts.
stocks:BA.recent: The news on Boeing this fortnight was about safety. A 737 turned back after a mid-air emergency in Iran, and Boeing then flagged a 737 MAX glitch that its own cockpit software update created, which can make an automated navigation feature fail during landing. The glitch came out after the last close shown, so it does not explain the slide.

stocks:LUV.standing: Shares of Southwest Airlines, the Dallas-based US carrier, traded on the New York Stock Exchange. It flies only Boeing 737s, so the stock answers to Boeing's deliveries and safety record as well as to jet fuel and fares.
stocks:LUV.recent: The one relevant story landed the day after the peak: Boeing said its own software update had created a landing fault on the 737 MAX, the jet Southwest's fleet is built around. It came too late to explain the climb before it, and nothing in the input accounts for that rise.

poly-will-alexandria-ocasio-cortez-win-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez wins the Democratic Party's 2028 presidential nomination. Its price is what traders pay for that outcome, moving on polls, endorsements and signals about a run.
poly-will-alexandria-ocasio-cortez-win-t.recent: Nothing in the fortnight's news touched Ocasio-Cortez or the nomination race, and none of it accounts for the price. The stories were about the venue itself: New York sued Polymarket for letting 18-to-20-year-olds bet where state law sets 21, and the Sixth Circuit ruled that states can regulate Kalshi's sports contracts.

stocks:UAL.standing: The parent company of United Airlines, one of the largest US carriers, with hubs in Chicago, Denver, Houston, Newark and San Francisco. Its shares move with jet fuel costs and demand for business and long-haul travel.
stocks:UAL.recent: The fortnight's main aviation news was Boeing's disclosure that its own software update created a landing fault on the 737 MAX, but nothing reported in the period accounts for the move in the share price.

wiki-xi-jinping.standing: Daily readers of the Wikipedia article on Xi Jinping, who has led China's Communist Party and armed forces since 2012 and its state since 2013. It jumps when he meets a US president or moves against his own elite.
wiki-xi-jinping.recent: Xi's first state visit to the US since 2015 opened on 23 September. It ended with the trade truce extended to January 10, $30bn in tariff cuts and a joint pledge to keep AI under human control. Xi also pressed Trump to change one word in US Taiwan policy. The visit came days after a purge left his own military commission with just two members.

stocks:AXISBANK.NS.standing: One of India's largest private-sector lenders, listed on the National Stock Exchange in Mumbai. Its shares follow Indian credit growth, retail and corporate lending, and the rate outlook set by the Reserve Bank of India.
stocks:AXISBANK.NS.recent: Indian bank unions called a three-day nationwide strike from September 28 to 30 to demand a five-day working week. Public-sector lenders such as SBI and PNB warned customers that branch services would be disrupted over quarter-end. None of this explains how Axis Bank's shares have traded.

stocks:ICICIBANK.NS.standing: ICICI Bank is one of India's largest private-sector lenders, based in Mumbai. It lends to both retail customers and companies, so its shares are a closely watched measure of Indian credit demand and the health of the banking system.
stocks:ICICIBANK.NS.recent: The only bank story in the window was a three-day nationwide strike by Indian bank unions demanding a five-day working week, called for September 28 to 30. It falls after the decline and targets public-sector lenders such as SBI and PNB, so it does not explain ICICI Bank's slide.

stocks:HDFCBANK.NS.standing: Shares of HDFC Bank, India's largest private-sector lender, listed on the National Stock Exchange in Mumbai. It carries one of the heaviest weights in India's benchmark indices, so its moves pull the wider market with it.
stocks:HDFCBANK.NS.recent: The only Indian banking news in this period was a three-day nationwide strike by bank unions from September 28 to 30 over a five-day working week. The strike starts after this series ends, and it is centred on public-sector lenders such as SBI and PNB, so it does not explain the move.

stocks:UNH.standing: UnitedHealth Group, the largest US health insurer, owns UnitedHealthcare and the Optum care and pharmacy-benefits business. Its shares move on Medicare Advantage payment rates and on how fast its members' medical costs rise.
stocks:UNH.recent: The only company news came two days after the last close, when UnitedHealthcare dropped prior authorization on 1,700 procedure codes. Nothing reported in the fortnight before explains the slide that came earlier.

poly-will-the-us-announce-a-diesel-expor.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Washington bans diesel exports by October 31. A ban would keep US refiners' output at home, cutting supply to the Latin American and European buyers who import American diesel.

poly-variational-fdv-above-2b-one-day-af.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Variational, a crypto derivatives trading platform, is valued above $2 billion on a fully diluted basis after its token launches. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome.

poly-bitcoin-all-time-high-by-december-3.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if bitcoin trades above its previous record price at any point before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves with bitcoin itself.
poly-bitcoin-all-time-high-by-december-3.recent: The trough came as the Clarity Act's prospects fell apart: Republicans rejected Democrats' counter-proposal on the crypto bill, and Bitcoin slipped with it. None of the reporting since explains the later rebound. New York's suit against Polymarket over illegal gambling is about the venue, not about Bitcoin.

wiki-anthropic.standing: Anthropic is the San Francisco artificial-intelligence company that makes the Claude models. Former OpenAI researchers founded it in 2021 as a public benefit corporation, and it built its name on AI safety.
wiki-anthropic.recent: Late in the month Anthropic cut Opus prices 40% with its 5.5 release. It then lost a 2-1 appeal against its supply-chain-risk blacklisting, and filed an IPO prospectus warning investors of existential risks to humanity, a disclosure that securities law gives legal weight. None of these stories dates from the early-September spike.

wiki-pakistan-tehreek-e-insaf.standing: Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf, the party Imran Khan founded in 1996, which took him to the prime minister's office in 2018 until a 2022 no-confidence vote removed him. Its base is strongest in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
wiki-pakistan-tehreek-e-insaf.recent: Police in Lahore jailed Imran Khan's sister Aleema Khan for 30 days ahead of PTI's march on Islamabad, and hospitals were told to clear beds. A Khyber Pakhtunkhwa minister was seized at gunpoint; chief minister Sohail Afridi vows to march on 4 October, joined by the opposition alliance TTAP, while Rana Sanaullah bars protest in Islamabad.

poly-will-magdalena-andersson-be-the-nex.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Magdalena Andersson, the Social Democrats' leader and a former prime minister, becomes Sweden's next PM. The Riksdag must tolerate the pick, so it trades on coalition arithmetic as much as votes.

poly-will-flvio-bolsonaro-finish-in-seco.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Bolsonaro candidate finishes second in Brazil's 2026 presidential election. Its price is what traders will stake on Brazil's right placing behind the winner, not a forecast.

poly-strait-of-hormuz-traffic-returns-to.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if shipping through the Strait of Hormuz returns to normal by its deadline. Most Gulf oil and gas exports leave through the strait, so the price is a running bet on that route reopening.
poly-strait-of-hormuz-traffic-returns-to.recent: After three hours of direct talks with Witkoff in New York, Iran offered to reopen Hormuz 7 days after the US agreed, and Trump rejected it. Explosions hit Qeshm Island hours later. Iran said Hormuz authorities will blacklist charterers, and an Iranian missile strike injured eight US Marines, each one a step further from ships moving normally.

poly-will-douard-philippe-win-the-2027-f.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Édouard Philippe, Macron's first prime minister and now mayor of Le Havre, wins France's 2027 presidential election. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome.

poly-us-iran-final-nuclear-deal-by-octob.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Washington and Tehran agree a nuclear deal by 31 October 2026. Its price is what traders will stake on that outcome, and it reprices within hours of any signal from either capital.
poly-us-iran-final-nuclear-deal-by-octob.recent: Iran offered to reopen Hormuz within 7 days, Trump rejected the offer on Saturday, and explosions hit Qeshm Island hours later. Days after that, TASS, citing Axios, reported that Trump would ease sanctions and unfreeze Iran's assets in exchange for nuclear concessions. Mehr said Araghchi was meeting Qatari mediators in New York.

poly-trump-renames-ai-by-september-30.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Donald Trump gives artificial intelligence a new official name before the end of September. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, not a forecast.
poly-trump-renames-ai-by-september-30.recent: The only AI story of the fortnight that involved Trump himself was his dinner invitation to Anthropic's Dario Amodei for Sunday. None of the reporting, from the dinner or from anything else, has him proposing a new name for AI, so nothing reported explains why traders bid the contract up.

stocks:BP.standing: London-based BP is one of the oil majors, producing, refining and trading oil and gas worldwide; this is its New York-listed share. It moves with crude and with the cash its upstream fields return to shareholders.
stocks:BP.recent: The one BP story in the input arrived after this window closed: Egypt's Petroleum Minister Karim Badawy told BP that Cairo would reject the sale of part of its Egyptian oil and gas assets to Israeli majority-owned Energean, according to sources speaking to Mada Masr. Nothing in the input explains the earlier rise.

stocks:000660.KS.standing: South Korea's second-largest company by market value, listed on the Korea Exchange in Seoul, and one of the world's biggest memory-chip makers. It is a leading supplier of the high-bandwidth memory that AI accelerators depend on.
stocks:000660.KS.recent: SK Hynix was reported to want Intel to make its memory chips in the US, at an Ohio fab, although Intel has not made memory since the 1980s. Together with Samsung it controls 83% of memory chips, and AI hardware depends on that supply. Neither story accounts for the share price's path.

poly-will-marine-le-pen-win-the-2027-fre.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Marine Le Pen, figurehead of France's National Rally, wins the 2027 presidential election. Its price moves on her legal eligibility to stand and on the far right's polling.
poly-will-marine-le-pen-win-the-2027-fre.recent: Nothing reported this fortnight touched France or Le Pen, so none of it accounts for the price. The election stories ran from India's voter-roll dissent row to AI tallies of Nigeria's results, and the prediction-market news concerned Polymarket itself, which New York sued for letting 18-to-20-year-olds bet.

stocks:7201.T.standing: Shares of Nissan, the Yokohama-based carmaker listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, priced in yen. The stock rides on its sales in the US and China and on its long alliance with France's Renault.
stocks:7201.T.recent: The only story about the company in the fortnight came from Paris: prosecutors asked for a four-year sentence for Rachida Dati over alleged paid lobbying for Renault-Nissan under Carlos Ghosn while she was an MEP. That case covers 2009-2013 and does not explain the fall in the share price.

stocks:MDA.standing: A Canadian space company that builds satellites, antennas and space robotics, the lineage behind the Canadarm arms on the Space Shuttle and the ISS. Its shares move on government and satellite-constellation contracts.
stocks:MDA.recent: The one story touching the company arrived after this chart closes: the ISS's 58-foot Canadarm2, the station's robotic arm, stopped moving after a routine maneuver. Nothing reported before then accounts for the share price.

stocks:NOC.standing: One of the largest US defence contractors, maker of the B-21 stealth bomber, the Sentinel ICBM programme and military satellites. Most of its revenue comes from the Pentagon, so its shares follow US defence budgets and contract awards.

stocks:MHVYF.standing: Japan's largest defence contractor, quoted here as a US over-the-counter listing in dollars. It builds gas turbines, nuclear plant components and the H3 rocket, so its shares track Tokyo's arms budget and global power demand.

stocks:MRK.standing: Shares in Merck & Co., the New Jersey drugmaker known as MSD outside North America. Its cancer immunotherapy Keytruda is among the world's best-selling drugs, so the stock trades on that franchise and on what replaces it once its patents lapse.
stocks:MRK.recent: The only Merck news of the fortnight came from Rahway at the very end of it: the company quietly stopped supplying a last-resort antibiotic used against drug-resistant infections. It arrived after both the stock's peak and its trough, so it does not account for either.

poly-putin-out-as-president-of-russia-by.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Vladimir Putin no longer holds Russia's presidency by mid-2027, for any reason. Its price is what traders pay for that outcome; Russia's next scheduled presidential vote is in 2030.
poly-putin-out-as-president-of-russia-by.recent: Bets on his exit eased as results showed Putin's party winning Russia's election. In the same days the EU delisted Alisher Usmanov and Mikhail Fridman, and Rubio said Putin was invited to the G20 Summit in December in Miami. Drone strikes on Moscow and the failed Lavrov talks carried no sign of a change at the top.

poly-us-x-iran-diplomatic-meeting-by-mar.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the United States and Iran hold a diplomatic meeting before the end of September. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it reprices each time either government signals openness or refusal.
poly-us-x-iran-diplomatic-meeting-by-mar.recent: Iran offered to reopen Hormuz within 7 days, and Trump rejected the proposal on Saturday. Explosions hit Qeshm Island hours later, and Tehran said it had seized a second US seabed drone. The only pull the other way was a TASS report, citing Axios, that Trump would offer Iran sanctions relief as Qatar-mediated talks continued.

stocks:MTNOY.standing: Africa's largest mobile operator, based in Johannesburg and listed there; this is its US over-the-counter share. Most of its earnings come from Nigeria, Ghana and South Africa, so swings in the naira and cedi move it.
stocks:MTNOY.recent: The only related report this fortnight, datelined Niamey, found that telecom firms have carried out roughly 100 African internet shutdowns since 2016. Nothing in it explains the share price.

stocks:CRM.standing: Shares of Salesforce, the San Francisco company whose cloud software runs sales, service and marketing for large businesses. It is the bellwether for subscription software, and trades on whether AI agents extend its seat-based model or replace it.
stocks:CRM.recent: The one relevant development was Meta launching a paid AI platform for businesses on Monday, which moved Meta into the enterprise software Salesforce sells. Nothing reported explains the rest of the slide, which began weeks earlier.

stocks:NOW.standing: ServiceNow sells cloud software that large companies use to run IT, HR and customer-service workflows. Its shares are a bellwether for corporate software budgets, and for whether AI adds to seat-based SaaS or replaces it.
stocks:NOW.recent: Meta launched a paid AI platform for businesses, taking a consumer-internet giant straight into the enterprise market where ServiceNow sells its own AI agents. That launch came only at the very end of the window, and nothing else carried here accounts for the slide that preceded it.

stocks:SNOW.standing: Snowflake sells a cloud data platform where companies store and query their corporate data, and bills by usage. Its shares are a gauge of how much enterprises spend on data infrastructure and AI workloads.
stocks:SNOW.recent: The only related news in the fortnight was Meta's launch of a paid AI platform for businesses in Menlo Park, and it came weeks after Snowflake's early-September swings. Nothing in the input explains why the stock moved.

stocks:MDB.standing: Shares of MongoDB, the New York company behind the widely used document database and its Atlas cloud service. Investors treat it as a gauge of how much companies spend on software infrastructure, including building AI applications.
stocks:MDB.recent: Monday's low came the same day Meta launched a paid AI platform for businesses, a move into the enterprise market that software makers sell to. None of the reporting explains the slide over the weeks before that.

poly-will-alexandria-ocasio-cortez-win-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, the New York congresswoman, wins the 2028 US presidential election. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it tracks the Democratic left's standing.
poly-will-alexandria-ocasio-cortez-win-t.recent: None of the fortnight's news touched the 2028 race, so none of it explains the move. The closest story was about the venue itself: New York sued Polymarket for letting 18-to-20-year-olds bet where state law sets 21.

stocks:AXON.standing: Axon Enterprise makes the Taser and the body cameras most US police forces wear, and sells the cloud software that stores their footage. Its revenue rests on multi-year contracts with police departments.
stocks:AXON.recent: The fortnight carried 404 Media asking readers whether their city uses Axon license plate cameras, and a vendor's pitch to Johnson City police to add facial recognition to Flock's plate cameras. Neither accounts for the fall in the share price.

poly-will-anthropic-ipo-by-december-31-2.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the privately held AI lab behind the Claude models, lists its shares on a public exchange before 2027. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome.

stocks:AMD.standing: The Santa Clara chipmaker that is Nvidia's main rival in AI accelerators and Intel's in PC and server processors. Its share price is a running bet on whether anyone can win AI data-centre spending away from Nvidia.
stocks:AMD.recent: The one big AMD story of the fortnight came after the rally, not before it: AMD agreed to pay $8.2 billion for Fei-Fei Li's World Labs, a 'world model' startup. The bet is that owning the software layer is how a chipmaker loosens Nvidia's CUDA-driven lock on AI compute. None of the reporting accounts for the climb before the deal.

poly-us-iran-final-nuclear-deal-by-decem.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the US and Iran sign a final nuclear agreement by the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on talks, sanctions and fighting in the Gulf.
poly-us-iran-final-nuclear-deal-by-decem.recent: Talks in New York turned on the terms for reopening Hormuz. Trump rejected Iran's offer to reopen the strait within 7 days. Hours later, explosions hit Qeshm Island, and Iran said it had seized a second US seabed drone. Two days after that, TASS, citing Axios, reported that Trump would offer Iran sanctions relief.

poly-will-samuel-alito-announce-his-reti.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Justice Samuel Alito announces his retirement from the US Supreme Court before 2026 ends. He is one of the court's oldest conservatives, and when he leaves decides which president and Senate fill the seat.

poly-iran-charges-hormuz-fees-by-septemb.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Iran imposes transit fees on ships crossing the Strait of Hormuz by its deadline. About a fifth of the world's seaborne oil passes through the strait, so a toll there reaches every tanker.
poly-iran-charges-hormuz-fees-by-septemb.recent: Iran offered to reopen Hormuz within 7 days, and Trump rejected the offer. Explosions hit Qeshm Island hours later. Mehr then said Hormuz authorities would blacklist charterers, which threatens the ships themselves rather than charging them a fee. Meanwhile the New York talks centred on the terms for reopening, and Trump weighed sanctions relief.

poly-another-fed-rate-hike-in-2026.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the US Federal Reserve raises its policy rate at least once more before 2026 ends. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on inflation data and on what Fed officials say.
poly-another-fed-rate-hike-in-2026.recent: The Fed voted 12-0 to raise rates because a closed strait had pushed up prices, defied Trump's calls to lower rates, and signalled more to come. That turned the bet into a question of whether it would move again this year. A week later, traders were pricing in 4 Fed rate hikes by June 2027.

poly-will-the-republicans-win-the-kansas.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Republican candidate wins Kansas's US Senate seat in November 2026. Kansas has not sent a Democrat to the Senate since the 1930s, so the price is a bet on whether that record holds.

wiki-france.standing: How many people open Wikipedia's article on France each day. It is a rough gauge of how far events in the country reach readers outside it, rising when elections, unrest or a state visit send people looking for background.
wiki-france.recent: The sharpest rise came the Sunday the National Rally won at least 14 Senate seats and its first Senate group, a day after Pope Leo pressed France on clerical abuse at Lourdes. Protests followed: 164 people were arrested at high school protests, and unions say 300,000 struck against Lecornu's austerity budget while police detained 440.

poly-us-x-iran-diplomatic-meeting-by-dec.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the US and Iran hold another meeting before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on every sign that talks are opening or breaking down.
poly-us-x-iran-diplomatic-meeting-by-dec.recent: Trump rejected Iran's offer to reopen Hormuz within 7 days, and explosions hit Qeshm Island hours later. The next day TASS, citing Axios, said Trump would offer Iran sanctions relief. Then Mehr News Agency reported that the US had answered Tehran's Hormuz conditions, so the channel had reopened after the rejection.

poly-israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the ceasefire between Israel and Iran is still in force on October 31. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on strikes, threats and talks between Washington and Tehran.
poly-israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-t.recent: Trump rejected Iran's Hormuz proposal on Saturday and oil surged $4. Within a day TASS, citing Axios, said he would offer Iran sanctions relief, and Mehr News Agency reported that the US had answered Tehran's Hormuz conditions. The contract now turns on whether that US–Iran channel keeps talking.

stocks:PBR.standing: Brazil's state-controlled oil company, traded in New York as dollar shares. Its deep-water output off Brazil ties it to crude, and Brasília's say over fuel prices and dividends ties it to politics.
stocks:PBR.recent: The only Petrobras news in the fortnight was a test of the Cardano blockchain to verify low-carbon fuel claims, and nothing in it accounts for the share price.

stocks:UBSFY.standing: Ubisoft, the French publisher behind Assassin's Creed and Far Cry, quoted here as a dollar share traded over the counter in the US. Its fortunes rest on a handful of big-budget releases a year.
stocks:UBSFY.recent: The one development touching the industry was an EU consumer investigation, run from Brussels, into how 9 video game companies sell virtual currencies. It came after this window closed, and nothing in it accounts for the share price.

stocks:EADSY.standing: Airbus's US over-the-counter shares, priced in dollars. Airbus builds roughly half the world's large passenger jets, so the stock turns on delivery rates, engine and supplier bottlenecks, and the euro.
stocks:EADSY.recent: The fortnight's only Airbus news was ESA picking Airbus Defence and Space and OHB to lead parallel feasibility studies for a European-led low-Earth-orbit station. That is a study contract in the space unit, and it does not account for the slide in a company whose value rests on airliners.

poly-will-samuel-alito-announce-his-reti.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Samuel Alito, a conservative US Supreme Court justice since 2006, announces his retirement by June 2027. A departure hands the president a nomination and the Senate a confirmation fight.

poly-will-anthropic-have-the-best-ai-mod.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic holds the top spot on the LMArena text leaderboard at the end of 2026. It prices a race among a handful of labs, where a single model release can reorder the ranking overnight.

poly-will-google-have-the-best-ai-model-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if a Google model ranks first on the LMArena text leaderboard at the end of October 2026. It is a direct bet on who leads the frontier-model race between Google, OpenAI, Anthropic and xAI.
poly-will-google-have-the-best-ai-model-.recent: This fortnight's news about prediction markets was about whether they are legal, not about AI models. New York sued Polymarket for letting 18-to-20-year-olds bet where state law sets 21, and an appeals court ruled that states can regulate Kalshi's sports contracts. None of it explains why traders moved toward Google.

poly-iran-leadership-change-by-october-3.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Iran's leadership changes before the end of October. Power sits with the Supreme Leader, who outranks the president and commands the armed forces, so a change at the top would reset Tehran's foreign policy.
poly-iran-leadership-change-by-october-3.recent: Late September was about bargaining with the government in Tehran, not challenging it. Iran offered to reopen Hormuz within 7 days, Trump rejected the offer, and explosions hit Qeshm Island. By the month's end Trump was weighing sanctions relief and Iran reported a US reply. None of it touched who holds power in Iran.

poly-will-sorin-grindeanu-be-the-next-pr.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Sorin Grindeanu, a former Romanian prime minister and Social Democrat leader, becomes the country's next head of government. Its price is what traders will pay on that outcome.

poly-will-marco-rubio-win-the-2028-us-pr.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Marco Rubio, the Florida Republican, wins the 2028 US presidential election. Its price is what bettors will pay for that outcome, and it moves with his standing in the Republican field.
poly-will-marco-rubio-win-the-2028-us-pr.recent: The fortnight's news about the market itself was legal, not political: New York sued Polymarket for letting 18-to-20-year-olds bet where state law sets 21. None of it concerned Rubio or the 2028 race, and none of it accounts for the price.

stocks:C.standing: Shares of Citigroup, one of Wall Street's largest banks, listed on the New York Stock Exchange. More of its revenue comes from outside the US than any big American lender's, so the stock follows global trade and dollar funding flows.

poly-gemini-4pt0-released-by-october-31-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Google publicly releases Gemini 4.0, the next generation of its flagship AI model family, by 31 October 2026. It shows what traders will pay on Google's release timing in the race among AI labs.
